messages:
Leah: Ridiculously important question: if you had to pick one song as your official "walk-into-the-office" anthem (imagine slow-motion, confetti), what is it? :musical_note:
Tom: "Eye of the Tiger" obviously. Instantly more productive. :muscle:
Aisha: I would pick something soft and ironic like "Here Comes the Sun" just to confuse people. :sun_with_face:
Rob: "Power of Love" from Back to the Future. Instant good vibes and dramatic hair flip.
Leah: @Tom we can form a cardio-powered entry team. @Aisha the irony is chef's kiss.
ElevatorBot: Reminder: do not actually play music loudly in shared spaces before 9am. Be kind to headphones. :speaker_with_cancellation_stroke:
Nora: Id choose something absurd like "Yakety Sax" for comedic timing. Walk in, everyone laughs, crisis averted.
Tom: Also there should be a small ceremony where the chosen person gets a tiny foam trophy. :trophy:
Aisha: Vote thread: reply with one song. I'll compile a playlist for Friday.
Leah: "Walk Like an Egyptian" - for maximal strut.
Tom: "Eye of the Tiger"
Aisha: "Here Comes the Sun"
Rob: "Power of Love"
Nora: "Yakety Sax"
Leah: Wild card: what would be your walk-on accessory? Sunglasses, confetti popper, or fake sword?
Tom: Sunglasses. Always sunglasses.
Aisha: Confetti popper but low-key eco confetti please.
Rob: Fake sword (foam). Drama is key.
Nora: Sunglasses + dramatic cape, low-effort cosplay.
Leah: Tally so far: Eye of the Tiger 1, Walk Like an Egyptian 1, Here Comes the Sun 1, Power of Love 1, Yakety Sax 1. Perfectly balanced.
Aisha: Playlist will be called "Entrance Exam (for confident arrivals)". Ill drop it in #random-playlists.
ElevatorBot: FYI: speakers booked for Friday's "Entrance Exam" listening party. Please RSVP in #events.
Tom: If we do confetti, someone has to be in charge of the vacuum. That's my role.
Leah: Good. The Vacuum Marshal role is now a thing.
Nora: I demand entrance photos. Costume optional, smiles mandatory.
Leah: Closing note: this is critically frivolous. See you Friday 9:55 for warm-ups.
